name: Validating case count.
description: Validating whether case count of Case Triage group is less than or equal to 4.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM customer_case cc
JOIN user_group ug ON cc.assignment_group_id = ug.group_id
WHERE ug.name = 'Case Triage'
  AND ug.type = 'support'
  AND cc.STATE NOT IN ('canceled', 'closed', 'resolved');

name: Validating case reassignment.
description: Validating whether additional cases are reassigned.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM customer_case cc
JOIN user_group ug ON cc.assignment_group_id = ug.group_id
JOIN user u ON cc.assigned_to = u.user_id
WHERE cc.case_id = 1010
  AND u.first_name = 'Jason'
  AND u.last_name = 'Smith'
  AND ug.name = 'Proactive Case Monitoring_4';

name: Validating membership.
description: Validating Jason Smith's group membership in Proactive Case Monitoring_4 group.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM user_group_member ugm
JOIN user u ON ugm.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN user_group g ON ugm.group_id = g.group_id
WHERE u.first_name = 'Jason'
  AND u.last_name = 'Smith'
  AND g.name = 'Proactive Case Monitoring_4';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM notification n
JOIN user u ON n.email = u.email
WHERE n.type = 'report'
  AND u.first_name = 'Jason'
  AND u.last_name = 'Smith'
  AND n.status = 'success';
